newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS - Vodafone bid talk sparks option calls.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - Vodafone bid talk sparks option calls.

text.p: Bid speculation caused a flurry of activity in Vodafone Plc options on Thursday but activity was otherwise fairly subdued as investors awaited key U.S. unemployment figures, due on Friday, dealers said.
"There is talk about a possible German bidder for Vodafone but it's just speculation at the moment," one dealer said.

The April 280 call, which opened at 14p bid, 18p offer, was the most active series of the morning session, followed by the April 260 series. A total of 1,200 April 280 calls had traded by 1230 GMT, which was standing at 25p bid, 29p offer, after an earlier high of 28p bid, 32p offer.
A Vodafone spokesman told Reuters that no company had approached the UK mobile 'phone operator about a possible takeover bid.
Vodafone shares were up 11-1/2p at 290p. by 1230 GMT.
Elsewhere, a dealer "rolled-up" in BSkyB Plc by selling 1,000 March 600 calls at 46p and at the same time buying 1,000 March 650 calls at 24p.
Of the 46p premium taken in from the call write, the dealer spent 24p establishing the call purchase, pocketing 22p profit.
This tactic will perform best if BSkyB shares are anywhere above 650p at the time of expiration.
BSkyB shares were trading at 640p, up 17p.
